quality_evidence_matrix.command_or_test: bun run test; bunx tsc -b; bun run validate:vocabulary; pseudocode_validate; tied_validate_consistency; binding_inventory_validate; lint_yaml
quality_evidence_matrix.evidence_method: Project test suite, TypeScript build, vocabulary validation, strict pseudo-code validation, TIED consistency, binding inventory gate, YAML lint.
quality_evidence_matrix.limitation: Structural and executable checks do not prove unrelated security, performance, privacy, or usability properties.
quality_evidence_matrix.rationale: Every alignment tranche must preserve executable regression and TIED integrity.
quality_evidence_matrix.threshold: All required commands exit 0; structural validators pass or document approved exceptions.

quality_evidence_matrix.command_or_test: src/app/api/mesh/*.route.test.ts; src/app/api/files/route.test.ts malformed-input cases; mesh import-export.route.test.ts
quality_evidence_matrix.evidence_method: Route-level composition tests fire HTTP triggers with invalid payloads and RBAC headers without UI.
quality_evidence_matrix.limitation: Does not prove full abuse-case coverage or production deployment hardening.
quality_evidence_matrix.rationale: Mesh API and files API accept external JSON/path input; inventory rows mesh.api.* and files.api.* map to route composition tests.
quality_evidence_matrix.threshold: Malformed input and auth rejection tests pass in Vitest route composition suite.

quality_evidence_matrix.command_or_test: WorkspaceView.*.test.tsx; Toolbar*.test.tsx; useElementSize.test.ts; e2e_only rows workspace.ui.* in binding-inventory.yaml
quality_evidence_matrix.evidence_method: UI-free component/contract tests for toolbar and layout; Playwright E2E justified for browser-only seams.
quality_evidence_matrix.limitation: Vitest jsdom does not prove visual accessibility or real browser focus order.
quality_evidence_matrix.rationale: Workspace panes, toolbar, and linked navigation are user-facing; composition tests cover programmatic seams; browser keyboard nav marked e2e_only.
quality_evidence_matrix.threshold: Component tests pass; e2e_only_reason names browser/Playwright constraint for UI-only bindings.

quality_evidence_matrix.evidence_method: Domain validation composition tests and workspace snapshot round-trip API tests.
quality_evidence_matrix.limitation: Does not prove live filesystem mesh depot sync or concurrent mutation safety.

quality_evidence_matrix.threshold: Snapshot round-trip and domain validation composition tests pass.
